description.narrative: Stöd till UNODC:s program som syftar till att relevanta myndigheter, aktörer inom civilsamhälle och privat näringsliv i Myanmar med ökad effektivitet förhindrar, ökar medvetenheten om, upptäcker, utreder och åtalar korruption.
Support for UNODC's programs aimed at relevant authorities in Myanmar to more effectively prevent, raise awareness, detect, investigate and prosecute corruption.

The overall objective of the programme is "Myanmar more effectively prevents, raises awareness of, detects, investigates and prosecutes corruption". The expected outcomes are the following: Outcome 1: Improved legal and policy environment to support the Governments anticorruption efforts in line with international standards Outcome 2: Enhanced institutional capacity to prevent, raise awareness of, detect, investigate and prosecute corruption Outcome 3: Strengthened integrity of the judiciary and prosecution Outcome 4: Improved capacity of civil society organisations and private sector to prevent and contribute to combating corruption

Many results have been achieved and reported on in the intervention. Most of these are on an output rather than outcome level. Nevertheless, they are satisfactory given that the set targets and the outcome level results have been quite ambitious in relation to the high level of and state of corruption in Myanmar when the project started in 2017 and given the recent political developments in the country. The military coup on 1 st February 2020 and the political turmoil have also had a major impact on the project with many deviations of plans and difficulties in sustaining the already achieved results.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
